layout_and_spacing.philosophy: F-Pattern Hierarchy, Dense 'Control Room' grid for dashboards, Dual-pane for side-by-side OCR review.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px crisp borders, border-[#0A0A0C]/10. Remove soft shadows.
layout_and_spacing.radii: Max 4px rounded (rounded-sm) for a rigid, brutalist tech feel.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Grid Borders strategy. Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layout for data tables.

components.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Dark background (#0A0A0C) with white text. High contrast focus rings (ring-2 ring-[#002FA7] ring-offset-2).
components.cards: Flat background (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (#0A0A0C/10), no shadow. Hover: slight border color darken, no translation.
components.side_by_side_viewer: Dual-pane layout. Left: Fixed image scan with SVG bounding boxes overlay (green/yellow/red). Right: Resizable structured data form (Shadcn Input/Select) using IBM Plex Mono.
components.tables: Dense. border-collapse. Text aligned left. Status indicators (green/red dots) instead of full badges.
components.navigation: Sticky left sidebar (collapsible) or rigid top header with solid background (#FFFFFF) and bottom border. Active states marked with heavy 2px left border.

interaction_and_motion.hover: Explicit text and background changes. E.g., hover:bg-[#F4F4F6] hover:text-[#0A0A0C].
interaction_and_motion.transitions: Fast, precise. transition: all 0.15s ease-in-out. Disable all bouncy spring animations.
interaction_and_motion.accessibility: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast. aria-hidden on decorative elements.

icons_and_assets.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: Regular or Bold for crispness in dense data UI).

development_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='upload-document-button', data-testid='ocr-confidence-score').
development_rules.shadcn: Heavily customize shadcn components to remove 'soft' styling. Strip large border radii and soft shadows. Use crisp borders.
development_rules.html: For raw layout, use standard HTML tags (div, section) styled with Tailwind over pre-packaged layout components.
development_rules.files: Use .js or .jsx files, NOT .tsx. Provide the implementation in standard JavaScript.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Light Theme, Swiss Brutalist UI. Build a dashboard with 'Control Room Grid' (Mode B). Create a dual-pane side-by-side OCR review UI with fixed left scan and resizable right data fields. Implement drag-and-drop upload. Strictly adhere to text-color contrast, minimal rounded corners (max 4px), and 1px crisp grid borders. Do NOT use soft shadows. Do NOT use generic inter font. Use data-testid on every interactive element.
